contact_sides.value: Bottom- and top-contact parts fix which cable face must touch; a same-side (type A, 'Same Side') cable presents its contacts on one face at both ends, an opposite-side ('Inverting', type D) cable on opposite faces. Whether a Z or a U path needs A or D depends on the orientation of the two connectors and is a geometry ruling. Dual-contact parts (Megastar ZX-...-HFJ, XUNPU FPC-05FB, HDGC 1.0-B) accept either face, so with a dual part at one end either cable type works
